settings.name: Mindlab Solutions
settings.description: Brand strategy, thoughtful content, and focused paid campaigns for B2B and B2C businesses.

home.eyebrow: A clear plan. A connected approach.
home.title: Build a clearer brand. Reach the right customers.
home.description: Bring your brand strategy, content, and paid ads together. Mindlab helps B2B and B2C businesses turn a good offer into a clearer story—and a focused plan to get it seen.

packages.name: Brand Blueprint
packages.description: Get clear on who you serve, what you stand for, and how to talk about it. A practical foundation for your next marketing move.
packages.timeline: About 2–3 weeks after inputs and interviews.
deliverables: A review of 3 competitors and 1 priority buyer profile
Positioning, value proposition, and message hierarchy
packages.idealFor: Businesses launching, refining their offer, or struggling to explain their difference.

packages.name: Content Studio
packages.description: Turn your knowledge into useful, consistent writing. Build a content rhythm around the questions your customers actually ask.
packages.timeline: A monthly writing and review cycle.
deliverables: A 45-minute expert or source interview each month
8 written social posts for 1 profile or page
1 article up to 1,200 words OR 1 email up to 800 words
packages.idealFor: Businesses with expertise to share and limited time to turn it into consistent content.

packages.name: Demand Campaigns
packages.tagline: Put your offer in the right places.
packages.description: Build a focused paid campaign around one offer, then review and refine it. Clear scope, regular optimization, and media costs you can see.
packages.timeline: Weekly optimization and a monthly review.
deliverables: Management of up to $10,000 in monthly media spend
Up to 4 new ad copy variants per month
Weekly optimization and a monthly report and review
exclusions: New design, photography, or video production
Product feeds, extensive tracking, or CRM implementation
packages.idealFor: Businesses with a clear offer, a ready destination, and a separate budget for advertising.

industries.name: Professional services
industries.challenge: Your expertise is valuable. Making the difference easy to understand is the next step.
industries.approach: Clarify your positioning, turn expert insight into useful content, and focus campaigns on the right business problem.

industries.name: Technology & IT
industries.examples: IT providers, MSPs, and technology consultancies
industries.challenge: Buyers need to understand the business value behind the technical detail.
industries.approach: Translate complex services into clear messages, explain common decisions, and connect campaigns to a focused offer.

industries.name: Recruiting & training
industries.challenge: Different audiences need different reasons to choose you.
industries.approach: Define a priority buyer, develop relevant expert content, and run a campaign around one specific service or program.

industries.name: Home & consumer services
industries.examples: Home improvement and local service businesses
industries.challenge: Customers need to see what you offer and know what to do next.
industries.approach: Make the offer clear, answer practical questions, and focus paid campaigns on a specific service and market.

industries.name: Fitness, beauty & lifestyle
industries.examples: Studios, personal care, and lifestyle businesses
industries.challenge: An appealing experience needs an equally clear first step.
industries.approach: Build a consistent voice, write content around customer concerns, and promote a defined introductory offer.

industries.name: Retail & consumer brands
industries.challenge: The right product story connects features to a reason to care.
industries.approach: Refine product messaging, develop content themes, and plan a focused campaign. Stores, feeds, assets, and purchase tracking need a separate scope review.
industries.action: Product interest or purchases where tracking is ready

projects.title: A clearer story for a complex service.
projects.label: Sample concept
projects.summary: Making a fictional advisory firm's offer easier to understand, from its positioning to its first content themes.
projects.headline: Clarity for your next chapter.
projects.context: Northline Advisory is a fictional business used to demonstrate our thinking. The brief: help an advisory firm explain its work to owners preparing for their next stage of growth. This is an original Mindlab concept, not a client engagement.

decisions.title: Start with the buyer's decision.
decisions.body: Focus the message on owners weighing their next business move. Describe the decision they face before introducing the advisory process.

decisions.title: Build one consistent message.
decisions.body: Use a positioning idea—clarity for your next chapter—to connect the website introduction, service explanation, and content themes.

decisions.title: Turn expertise into useful questions.
decisions.body: Organize content around readiness, tradeoffs, and next steps. Each theme gives the business a practical way to share its thinking.

projects.takeaway: The concept shows how positioning can guide content. It has not run as a campaign and has no client results or performance claims.

projects.title: A first step that feels within reach.
projects.label: Sample concept
projects.summary: Connecting a fictional fitness studio's approachable voice to a focused introductory campaign.
projects.headline: A little stronger. Every day.
projects.context: Daybreak Studio is a fictional fitness business created for this demonstration. The brief: make an introductory program feel approachable to people who are curious about training but unsure where to start. This is an original sample, not client work.

decisions.title: Name the real hesitation.
decisions.body: Write for someone who wants to begin but worries they won't fit in. Keep the tone welcoming, specific, and free of transformation promises.

decisions.title: Connect the offer and the content.
decisions.body: Use the same message across a sample social post and an ad concept. Explain what a first session involves so the next step is easier to assess.

decisions.title: Plan the campaign before spending.
decisions.body: Choose one introductory offer, one local market, and one ad platform. Confirm the booking destination and measurement before launch.

projects.takeaway: This sample demonstrates a content and campaign direction. The visual is a presentation concept; design production is separately scoped. No campaign was run and no results are claimed.

faqs.question: Do we need all three services?
faqs.answer: No. Start with the work that solves your immediate problem. If your positioning is already clear, you can begin with Content Studio or Demand Campaigns. We can review fit together before agreeing a scope.

faqs.question: Is advertising spend included?
faqs.answer: No. Demand Campaigns is a management fee. Your media budget is additional and paid through your advertising account. The package covers up to $10,000 in monthly media spend; larger budgets need a separate scope.

faqs.question: Does Content Studio include design or video?
faqs.answer: The listed package is writing-only. Graphics, photography, video, community management, and email distribution or automation are separately scoped.

faqs.question: How long is the engagement?
faqs.answer: Brand Blueprint is a project, usually taking about 2–3 weeks after inputs and interviews. Our proposed retainer terms start with 90 days, then continue monthly with 30 days' notice. Your written agreement confirms the final terms.

faqs.question: Who owns the accounts and work?
faqs.answer: Your business owns its advertising accounts and data. Ownership and transfer of deliverables follow the written agreement. We do not guarantee a number of leads, sales, or revenue.
